BlueJay
Tingmiaq is a blue jay that can be found next to  Apikusis in the Sacred Pool of the Emerald Grove in Act One.

Involvement

Act One

Upon entering the Sacred Pool, Apikusis can be seen speaking to Tingmiaq. As the party approach, Tingmiaq flies off to complete a mission.

If the Grove is raided and all druids are killed, Tingmiaq's corpse is at the party's campsite during the night celebration with the goblins and  Minthara. A Goblin Tracker confirms having killed it with an arrow through the neck.

Speak with Animals

Tingmiaq can be spoken to via  Speak with Animals. However, he is in a hurry and only answers one question.

  • Where are you going?
    • Tingmiaq
      To find  Halsin. There's not a moment to lose!
  • What's the rush?
    • Tingmiaq
      I have to find Halsin. There's not a moment to lose!
  • I need information, friend. Spare me a moment? (if speaker is a Druid)
    • Tingmiaq
      For one of our own. But be quick.
      • What's waiting for us outside this grove? In the wilds?
        • Tingmiaq
          Goblins. Gnolls. All manner of monsters!
        • Tingmiaq
          Goblins. Gnolls. Even elves that look like you. (if speaker is a Drow)
        • Tingmiaq
          Goblins. Gnolls. Even a couple of your underground cousins. (if speaker is an Elf or Half-Elf)
  • Do you know Baldur's Gate? Is the city far? (if speaker is Baldurian)
    • Tingmiaq
      I know these hills, and there's no city here.
  • I'm looking for the druid Halsin. Where is he?
    • Tingmiaq
      That's what I'm trying to find out!
